data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Keen was an epithet of the goddess Athena, symbolizing her wisdom and swiftness. The name can also mean 'sharp' or 'clever'. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. There's no direct association between the name and the Christian faith, but it can serve as a reminder of the importance of maintaining a sharp mind and being quick to respond to the call of God in our lives.
